summary: Analyzes and visualizes single-neuron spiking activity in the macaque dorsal premotor cortex by decomposing trial-binned firing rate tensors across task-specific variables.
use_when: How does PMd neural activity change with stimulus difficulty?
Visualize trial-averaged firing rates for macaque premotor neurons
Perform tensor decomposition on single-neuron spike trains
Analyze PMd spiking activity sorted by choice and coherence
Generate PSTHs for perceptual decision-making neurons
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
